out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO DRY STORAGE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 90F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE THIS SINK CAN MEET 100F AT A MINIMUM BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED BOTH HANDWASHING SINKS IN THE PREP KITCHEN MISSING SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A COPY OF HANDWASHING SIGNAGE THAT CAN BE POSTED AT THE SINKS. PLEASE ENSURE SIGNAGE IS POSTED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED PANEER AT 50F, COOKED POTATOES AT 51F, CUT LETTUCE AT 49F, SLICED TOMATOES AT 48F, POTATO PATTIES AT 50F, AND UNSALTED BUTTER AT 47F IN THE TWO-DOOR PREP TOP (NEXT TO FREEZER); OBSERVED RASMALAI AT 53F, CREAM CHEESE AT 49F, AND WHIPPED CREAM AT 47-52F IN THE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COLDLINE COOLER IN PREP KITCHEN HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE THESE COOLERS ARE NOT USED UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED. COUNTRY OVEN (Inspection Date: 08/04/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food items for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED MULTIPLE BATCHES OF BIRYANI, VADA, AND DOSA ON TIME WITHOUT A FOUR-HOUR TIME LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL PROCEDURES WITH THE STAFF. EHS WILL ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AT TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: VARIOUS SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS NOT IN ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER HAVE A PROPER LABEL.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: OBSERVED MOUSE DROPPINGS ALONG THE FLOOR (NEAR THE WALK-IN COOLER) IN THE BACK OF THE PREP KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC PROVIDED EHS WITH THE MOST RECENT PEST CONTROL INVOICE (8/3/26). PLEASE ENSURE PEST CONTROL CONTINUES TO TREAT THE ESTABLISHMENT PER THEIR RECOMMENDATIONS AND THAT THE ESTABLISHMENT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD ITEMS STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. PLEASE ENSURE ALL STAFF WEAR PROPER HAIR RESTRAINTS.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED CUPS/BOWLS WITHOUT HANDLES STORED INSIDE OF VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS; OBSERVED SPATULAS FOR DESSERTS STORED IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS REVIEWED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: GARLIC PEEL manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE ENSURE THESE CONTAINERS ARE NOT REUSED AS THEY ARE NOT NSF APPROVED AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING UNITS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE THESE COOLERS ARE REPAIRED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE ALL EQUIPMENT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED TWO SMALL HOLES IN THE CEILING IN THE PREP KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PLEASE SEAL THESE HOLES WITH FOAMING CAULK OR NEW CEILING TILES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD DEBRIS AND GRIME ACCUMULATION ON THE FLOORS/WALLS AROUND COOK-LINES AND DISHWASHING MACHINE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE THE ENTIRE ESTABLISHMENT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. COUNTRY OVEN (Inspection Date: 08/04/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ABOVE PRODUCE IN BOTH WALK-IN COOLERS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLERS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. OBSERVED THREE- VAT SINK IN CATERING KITCHEN WITHOUT AIR-GAPS OR AIR-BREAKS.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. EHS PROVIDED PROPER THREE-VAT CONFIGURATION DIAGRAM TO PIC. PIC UNDERSTANDS THE FACILITY SHOULD HAVE THIS CORRECTED WITHIN 10 DAYS. IF YOU HAVE QUESTIONS, PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED Y SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC UNDERSTANDS APPROVED SPLITTER SHOULD BE OBTAINED PRIOR TO THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
